{{Top|leg}}
The '''''FV50''''' was a standard [[Motivator/Legends|motivator]] unit used in [[Service droid/Legends|service droids]].

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] had a device designed and installed within himself that allowed him to take the FV50 and turn it into a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] power supply. By taking this double-cylindrical object, stripping out the internal circuit and then high-grading the output power, he was able to create enough power for a few [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster]] bolts.
